overview.description: The VistaShares Target 15 USA Quality Income ETF (QUSA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks to generate a 15% annual income through a mix of US equities and an active options strategy. The fund aims for steady income alongside potential long-term capital growth by prioritizing firms with strong financial stability and low earnings variability QUSA was launched on May 6, 2025 and is issued by VistaShares.

data.title: VistaShares Adds to Income ETF Suite with Launch of VistaShares Target 15™ USA Quality Income ETF (QUSA)
data.text: SAN FRANCISCO & BOSTON & NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--VistaShares adds to Target 15 ETF family with QUSA, first ETF to combine factor investing with income-producing options overlay.

news.t: VistaShares Adds to Income ETF Suite with Launch of VistaShares Target 15™ USA Quality Income ETF (QUSA)

holdings.infoBox: QUSA is an equity ETF with a total of 88 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 6.43%, NVIDIA at 6.35%, Lam Research at 6.27%, Alphabet at 5.42%, and Microsoft at 5.17%.
